svg.text: One relation over 36 edge-pairs; filled cells run the ~1,817-mul accumulate body, dim cells cost (almost) nothing. Mega applies ~2 of 14 relations per active row.

svg.text: every edge-pair runs the full body, active or not — a data-parallel machine pays for zeros.
